entries.en: to plug holes; to stop up, block
〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: 西语栏两处残损且声调号污损，仅汉字'感/cam'可辨，与 tapar 语义衔接不明。

entries.en: to cover the hem or flap (resgallo); to fold over, close up
entries.notes: 仅一声调号污损，文字清晰；resgallo 取 17 世纪'衣边/褶边'义。

entries.en: to cover with tapestries or hangings; to screen off (entapizar)
entries.notes: 一声调号污损；M 栏三音节对单字'障'，音节与汉字对应存疑。

entries.en: to stop up holes; to block, plug
entries.notes: 一声调号污损；M 栏两音节对单字'杜'，'chai'音节对应存疑。

entries.en: to close, shut up (a door); to bar
entries.notes: 西语 cexar 疑为 cerrar、'24'疑为参号；汉字'閈'疑为'閉'之形误，故取'閉塞'义。

entries.zh: 整落去（按下放好，嵌入盖住）
entries.en: to fit or press down into place and cover
entries.notes: 西语 cajando/cayando 之辨未定；释义依汉字'整落去'（放妥按下）取'嵌入盖住'。

entries.en: to plaster with mud; to stop up holes in a wall
entries.notes: 仅一声调号污损，语义清晰（糊土正合糊补墙洞）。

entries.en: to pull the quilt over; to cover with the bedspread (colcha)
entries.notes: 仅一声调号污损，语义清晰。

entries.zh: 闩上系紧（閂帶）；门闩系带
entries.en: bolted and fastened shut; door-bolt strap
entries.notes: 西语 pueth/puens 之辨未定；'閂帶'或读'闩住带牢'表闩紧，或为名词'门闩带'。

entries.zh: 塞住固牢（塞帶：塞而带住）
entries.en: to plug and keep shut; stopped fast
entries.notes: '帶'在此疑作'带住、固守'解，与'塞'合成'塞牢'；主义依塞/tapar 明确。

entries.en: to plug well; to seal tight
to cover so as not to be seen; to screen, conceal
to cover for shelter or protection; to screen
entries.notes: 西语尾部 delacorte 为罕见连写（疑残文连读），释义依 amparando（庇护）与汉字'遮栏'。

entries.en: to cover over; to close down upon (cubrir)

entries.zh: 盖炭（封盖炉火焖烧成炭）
entries.en: to bank the fire to make charcoal
entries.notes: 声调号污损且 M 栏 im/in 之辨未定；大义依西语'盖火制炭'与汉字'蓋炭'。

entries.zh: 封螺口（塞住螺壳口；后字未辨）
entries.en: to stop or close the mouth of a snail shell
entries.notes: 声调号污损，痞/疵与 te/le 之辨未定；大义依西语'塞住螺口'。

entries.en: wall (tapia, rammed earth; pared)
wall (tapia or pared); wall

entries.zh: 三合土（夯筑土墙之灰砂土合料）
entries.en: rammed earth (tapia); lime-sand-earth aggregate
entries.notes: 一声调号污损；'三合土'正合 tapia 夯土之义。

entries.en: to ram, pound (earth) for walling (tapiar)
entries.notes: 汉字'春'依 tapiar（夯土）当为'舂'（捣实）之用字，属推断。

entries.en: to ram a wall; rammed-earth walling
entries.notes: 词头't.'为未展开缩写，依推断处理；'春'同上条作'舂'解。
